data.name: Abeden
data.gender_notes: Abeden is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Abeden is derived from the Hebrew word ‘abad’, meaning ‘to serve’. In the Bible, there is a figure named Abidan, who is a Levite and a gatekeeper for the Ark of the Covenant. This name is a reminder of the servant's role and dedication to God in the religious community. The name Abeden carries the meaning “Servant of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Abeden usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Abeden is a name of devotion and dedication to God, symbolizing a person's commitment to serving God and following God's will.
data.etymology: Abeden belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abeden total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

In the New Testament, Abaddon is a name given to the angel of the Abyss or the pit in the Book of Revelation (11:14-18) and is identified as 'Abaddon, or Abyss, or the Destroyer'.
